findings.description: Direct review of the current front, back, left, right, three-quarter, neutral, arms-up, arm-cross, crouch, sit, and prone renders shows a dense, sharply faceted overskirt with an uneven, ballooned pleat silhouette in neutral views. In crouch and sit, angular panels lift and jut around the thighs while the center-front layer falls behind the legs; coverage remains visibly poor. The V175 hem-edge pin is measured only in neutral and does not make the posed result acceptable.

Gray, body-colored-looking patches and hard surface facets remain visible on the ivory chest and waist in the front and posed views. Their cause is not established by these images; appearance is visibly defective and requires resolving the surface construction or shading before acceptance.

nextAction: Keep V175 rejected. The topology-selected attachment located 354 source hem vertices, ignored 183 other open boundary edges, and measured zero neutral hem drift; this confirms only neutral attachment. All eleven fresh renders still show an unacceptable skirt silhouette, bent-leg coverage, and bodice surface artifacts. Next isolate the skirt cloth response while preserving the authored hem attachment, and measure actual panel deformation, inversion, body clearance, and left/right bent-thigh coverage before modifying the bodice. Fit, Shape Key response, Unity/VRChat execution, package, and release remain unverified.
